    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rs = [-1] + div_rows + [h]
    cs = [-1] + div_cols + [w]
    div_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in div_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in div_cols}
    freq = {}
    for row in grid:
        for x in row:
            if x not in div_colors:
                freq[x] = freq.get(x, 0) + 1
    marker = min(freq, key=freq.get)
    return [[int(sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(rs[i]+1,rs[i+1]) for c in range(cs[j]+1,cs[j+1])) == 2) for j in range(len(cs)-1)] for i in range(len(rs)-1)]
''')
